specificationRepositoryChecked.note: The Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository publishes machine-readable specifications for SDDC Manager, VCF Installer, VCF Operations and related components. It publishes none for VCF Automation, and VCF PowerCLI 9.1.0.25380678 ships no VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Automation binding, so docs/contract.json was transcribed from rendered reference pages instead of projected from a specification.

pages.title: APIs - Broadcom Developer Portal
pages.documents: product index; used to establish that VCF Automation is published as xAPIs reference documentation and to locate the VM Apps Org Catalog and VM Apps Org Deployment API products

pages.title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Catalog - Operations Index
pages.documents: operation index for the catalog API product; used to locate the catalog item request operation

pages.title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Deployment - Operations Index
pages.documents: operation index for the deployment API product; used to locate the deployment and request operations

pages.title: Request Catalog Item Instances
pages.documents: summary 'Creates a deployment from a catalog item.', the id path parameter, bearerAuth, the CatalogItemRequest body members bulkRequestCount, deploymentName, inputs, projectId, reason and version with their types and maxLength constraints, and the 200 response array whose items carry only deploymentId and deploymentName

pages.title: Get Deployment By Id
pages.documents: summary 'Fetch a specific deployment.', the deploymentId path parameter, the optional query parameters expandLastRequest, expandResources, expandProject, expand and deleted with their descriptions, the Deployment response property list including lastRequest and inprogressRequests, and the Deployment status enumeration CREATE_SUCCESSFUL through DELETE_FAILED

pages.title: Get Request
pages.documents: summary 'Get the Request. Returns the request with the given ID.', the requestId path parameter, the full Request response schema including actionId, cancelable, completedTasks, deploymentId, id, name, outputs, requestedBy, status and totalTasks, the required members, and the Request status enumeration CREATED, PENDING, INITIALIZATION, CHECKING_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_PENDING, USER_INTERACTION_PENDING, INPROGRESS, COMPLETION, APPROVAL_REJECTED, ABORTED, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED

pages.title: Action Deployment Request
pages.documents: summary 'Submit action on requests. Allowable values: cancel, dismiss.', the note that cancel can be submitted on in-progress requests and dismiss on failed requests, the required action query parameter with values cancel and dismiss, the absence of a documented request body, and the 200 response that returns no data structure

pages.title: Submit Deployment Action Request
pages.documents: corroborating page for the Request response schema and its status enumeration, reached while confirming that the Request object returned by getRequestById is the same object exposed as the deployment's lastRequest; this operation is deliberately outside the focused contract

derivation.kind: hand transcription from rendered reference documentation pages
derivation.note: The reference pages publish no operationId, so docs/contract.json coins contract-local operationKey values. Each key maps to exactly one page above.
